caption: One continuous wilderness scene in the same shallow river and forest bank under natural daylight. The invariant subject is the same large brown bear with thick brown fur moving near the same water, mud, stones, grass, and dense green vegetation.
contrast_caption: A different animal, human, city, zoo enclosure, snowy field, beach, or indoor setting replaces the brown bear and riverbank.
invariant_caption: The same large brown bear remains in the same shallow river and forest-bank habitat with mud, stones, grass, and dense green vegetation.
